notes.title: Foe Frenzy Version 2: New Everything
notes.notes:
An update for Foe Frenzy was just released! The Steam, Discord and itch.io pages for the game also received a major overhaul along with this update. 
Courious about the new state of the game? Check out the highlighted sections in this copy of the new store page look! For a better insight into some of the new features, you can also check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1194170/view/2110440292534433122]the previous post[/url] about the public beta for this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36183830/a73493b86efdebfa33a8bd7094fe1fce9f962aad.png[/img]
Battle up to three of your friends locally or using online play. Pick up weapons, armor, healing items and more and use them to damage your enemies before they run out!

Play locally with up to two players on one keyboard and additional controllers, or use Steam, Discord or IP-based Multiplayer to battle over the internet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36183830/34d834772b23f3ed3b9c1a9cc37f59426e25cfc0.png[/img]
Use the terrain to your advantage on over [b]14 different maps[/b]. Run through hot deserts and wet swamps and chop through vines and [b]jump down cliffs[/b] to reach the best weapons; stumble through caves where your enemies lurk in the dark and make yourself vulnerable by swimming through lakes!

Select the map you're best at and hope that it gets picked over the ones that your friends chose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36183830/279bfdb6dcdc0e57fa3fc7bd2d565f6692188dbe.png[/img]
Fight with over [b]15 different items[/b], from swords, bows and leather armor to flamethrowers and [b]teleporters[/b]. Each item only lasts a short time, so choose carefully what move to make next!

[b]Pick up random effect items that cause a disadvantage to your opponents, but have a small chance of causing you trouble too. Slow down your friends, invert their controls, or make yourself invincible![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36183830/acf8cfeec63959e805bfd7cc18d6dfb35313c62c.png[/img]
Pick the color and the look of your battler. Unlock Achievements to gain access to more character designs!

[b]Once you're really good, enable expert mode for yourself for a greater challenge against your friends - lower HP, item durability and speed will make it more difficult for you to win![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36183830/e93489f9b8dd73fda733b6cb250a6c00b9ea666e.png[/img]
Defeat your friends before the timer runs out to win! The results screen shows how your friends were killed, and who killed them, so make your actions count!

[b]If the timer reaches a minute remaining, the game goes into Tiebreaker mode: Each player only has a single health point remaining until the end. Kill your last opponent in this exciting battle and emerge victorious![/b]
